extracted.intended_audience: poets and creative writers (especially those composing lyric or narrative poems intended for both popular and critical appreciation)
extracted.subtask_short: poem composition for unity and effect
extracted.subtask_description: Practical, stepwise principles for composing a poem focused on producing a single, powerful poetic effect (unity of impression), illustrated by Poe's account of composing "The Raven." Emphasises planning, sound, tone, length, and suggestiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Begin with the dénouement / compose from the end
rubrics_metrics.description: Every plot worth the name must be elaborated to its dénouement before anything be attempted with the pen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poe insists on planning the ending first so that incidents and tone at all points tend to the development of the intention; "the poem may be said to have its beginning—at the end." This avoids accidental or merely intuitive composition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select a single effect as the primary aim
rubrics_metrics.description: Commence with the consideration of an effect: of the innumerable effects ... what one shall I, on the present occasion, select?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a novel and vivid effect to guide all choices (incident, tone, sound). Keep originality in view and let the chosen effect determine structure, diction, and devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of impression — readable in one sitting
rubrics_metrics.description: If any literary work is too long to be read at one sitting, we must be content to dispense with the immensely important effect derivable from unity of impression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poe treats unity as essential for a poem: aim for totality of impression by keeping the work short enough to be consumed at once; long poems risk becoming merely sequences of brief effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit length to suit intensity (brevity ↔ intensity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Brevity must be in direct ratio to the intensity of the intended effect:—this, with one proviso—that a certain degree of duration is absolutely requisite for the production of any effect at all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a length that allows the desired intensity; for Poe's intended mix of popular and critical appeal he settled on about one hundred lines for The Raven (108).

rubrics_metrics.name: Make Beauty the province of the poem
rubrics_metrics.description: Beauty is the sole legitimate province of the poem; the pleasure most intense, elevating, and pure is found in the contemplation of the beautiful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat Beauty as an effect (an elevation of the soul) and subordinate Truth and Passion when required so as to serve the predominant aesthetic aim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adopt an appropriate tone — melancholy as highest poetic tone
rubrics_metrics.description: This tone is one of sadness. Beauty of whatever kind, in its supreme development, invariably excites the sensitive soul to tears. Melancholy is thus the most legitimate of all the poetical tones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If aiming at Beauty in its highest manifestation, a melancholic tone is appropriate; fix the tone early and shape incidents and diction to sustain it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decide whether effect arises from incident or tone (or both)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider whether [the effect] can be best wrought by incident or tone—whether by ordinary incidents and peculiar tone, or the converse, or by peculiarity both of incident and tone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weigh combinations of event and tone and select the mix that most efficiently produces the chosen effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek originality deliberately (often by negation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Originality ... is by no means a matter ... of impulse or intuition. In general, to be found, it must be elaborately sought, and although a positive merit of the highest class, demands in its attainment less of invention than negation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strive for original combinations (even if components are traditional); originality can require effort and conscious elimination of clichés.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of a refrain as an artistic pivot
rubrics_metrics.description: I betook myself to ordinary induction, with the view of obtaining some artistic piquancy which might serve me as a keynote ... no one had been so universally employed as that of the refrain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A refrain can be the structural pivot of a poem; consider how it will be applied and varied to heighten effect rather than merely repeating monotone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vary the thought of the refrain while keeping its sound
rubrics_metrics.description: I resolved to diversify, and so heighten, the effect, by adhering, in general, to the monotone of sound, while I continually varied that of thought: that is to say, I determined to produce continuously novel effects, by the variation of the application of the refrain—the refrain itself remaining, for the most part, unvaried.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the refrain's sonic identity but change its contextual meaning or application stanza-to-stanza to produce continuously novel emotional effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make the refrain brief—ideally a single word
rubrics_metrics.description: In proportion to the brevity of the sentence, would, of course, be the facility of the variation. This led me at once to a single word as the best refrain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A very short refrain (one word) gives maximal flexibility for varying its application and emotional force across stanzas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose the refrain for sonority and tone (long 'o' + 'r')
rubrics_metrics.description: That such a close, to have force, must be sonorous and susceptible of protracted emphasis ... led me to the long “o” as the most sonorous vowel, in connection with “r” as the most producible consonant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select sound shapes (vowels/consonants) that permit prolonged emphasis and match the poem's tone; Poe selected 'Nevermore' for its long 'o' and 'r' sonority plus melancholic sense.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select imagery/agents that plausibly enable the device (non-reasoning speaking creature)
rubrics_metrics.description: The difficulty lay in the reconciliation of this monotony with the exercise of reason on the part of the creature repeating the word. ... the idea of a non-reasoning creature capable of speech; ... a Raven ... infinitely more in keeping with the intended tone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you rely on repetitive verbal device, choose a speaker/agent for whom repetition is plausible (a non-reasoning creature) and that is emblematically suited to the tone (raven = bird of ill omen).

rubrics_metrics.name: Design escalating queries culminating in a climactic final question
rubrics_metrics.description: I could make the first query ... commonplace ... the second less so ... the third still less, and so on, until ... the lover ... is at length excited to superstition, and wildly propounds queries ... propounds them not altogether because he believes ... but because he experiences a phrenzied pleasure in so modeling his questions as to receive from the expected 'Nevermore' the most delicious because the most intolerable of sorrow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure the protagonist's interrogations to intensify progressively, each answer by the refrain gaining more emotional weight until the final, climactic query.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish the climax/stanza first to set rhythm and graduations
rubrics_metrics.description: I composed this stanza ... first that, by establishing the climax, I might the better vary and graduate, as regards seriousness and importance, the preceding queries of the lover; and, secondly, that I might definitely settle the rhythm, the meter, and the length and general arrangement of the stanza.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compose the climactic passage early to fix meter, rhythm, stanza-length, and to calibrate preceding material so none surpasses the climax; if necessary, purposefully weaken subsequent stanzas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Versification and stanza structure should serve the effect
rubrics_metrics.description: The effect of this originality of combination is aided by other unusual and some altogether novel effects, arising from an extension of the application of the principles of rhyme and alliteration. ... The former is trochaic—the latter is octameter acatalectic, alternating with heptameter catalectic repeated in the refrain ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose metrical feet, line lengths and stanzaic combinations that best support the emotional and sonic effect you intend; originality can lie in novel combinations even when individual lines/meter are traditional.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confine locale to concentrate attention (frame like a picture)
rubrics_metrics.description: A close circumscription of space is absolutely necessary to the effect of insulated incident: it has the force of a frame to a picture. It has an indisputable moral power in keeping concentrated the attention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place action in a tightly framed setting (e.g., a chamber) to focus the reader and intensify the isolated incident's impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use contrast (physical, tonal, material) to deepen impression
rubrics_metrics.description: I made the night tempestuous, first, to account for the Raven’s seeking admission, and, secondly, for the effect of contrast with the (physical) serenity within the chamber. ... the bird alight on the bust of Pallas, also for the effect of contrast between the marble and the plumage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introduce contrasts (storm vs. interior calm, ludicrous entrance vs. grave consequences, marble bust vs. living plumage) to heighten the eventual seriousness and emotional depth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduce suggestiveness / an under-current of meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: Two things are invariably required: first, some amount of complexity, or, more properly, adaptation; and, secondly, some amount of suggestiveness—some under-current, however indefinite, of meaning. It is this latter ... which imparts ... richness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond the surface narrative, embed suggestive elements so that the reader seeks moral or emblematic meaning; add a subtextual current to increase artistic richness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay explicit metaphorical/enigmatic meaning until late
rubrics_metrics.description: It will be observed that the words, 'from out my heart,' involve the first metaphorical expression in the poem. They, with the answer, 'Nevermore,' dispose the mind to seek a moral ... It is not until the very last line ... that the intention of making him emblematical of Mournful and Never-ending Remembrance is permitted distinctly to be seen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introduce metaphorical hints after the narrative foundation is laid, and reveal emblematic intent near the end so the under-current reframes earlier events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make incidents plausible with motivated causes
rubrics_metrics.description: I made the night tempestuous, first, to account for the Raven’s seeking admission ... the flapping of the wings ... as a 'tapping' at the door, originated in a wish to increase, by prolonging, the reader’s curiosity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide plausible, motivating circumstances for unusual incidents (e.g., storm drives bird to window; tapping mistaken for knock) to sustain believability while serving effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use character detail and setting to support the poem's thesis of Beauty
rubrics_metrics.description: The room is represented as richly furnished—this, in mere pursuance of the ideas I have already explained on the subject of beauty as the sole true poetical thesis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select furnishings, props (bust of Pallas), and character traits that display Beauty and help produce the intended emotional elevation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be prepared to sacrifice lesser passages to preserve climax
rubrics_metrics.description: Had I been able, in the subsequent composition, to construct more vigorous stanzas, I should, without scruple, have purposely enfeebled them, so as not to interfere with the climacteric effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize the climactic effect over isolated excellence elsewhere—deliberately moderate other sections to maintain the intended peak impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exploit sound devices (rhyme, alliteration, sonority) to heighten effect
rubrics_metrics.description: The effect of this originality of combination is aided by other unusual and some altogether novel effects, arising from an extension of the application of the principles of rhyme and alliteration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use rhyme schemes, repeated sounds, alliteration and the sonorous qualities of words to reinforce tone and the emotional resonance of refrains and lines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid the common 'events-first' mode—prefer effect-driven construction
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a radical error, I think, in the usual mode of constructing a story ... the author sets himself to work in the combination of striking events to form merely the basis of his narrative ... I prefer commencing with the consideration of an effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rather than assembling striking events and filling gaps later, choose the desired effect first and then select incidents, tone, and devices that best serve that effect.
